scope: SwirEngine 2.0 Milestone 8 — Performance Evidence & Competitive Quality Audit

measurement_policy.threshold_policy: Each workload keeps its existing in-repository regression budget and deterministic correctness invariants; the Milestone 8 harness records context and observations without weakening those thresholds.
measurement_policy.cross_engine_runtime_reason: No identical workload, rendering backend, asset set and packaging/runtime harness is currently maintained across the referenced engines, so cross-engine FPS or elapsed-time rankings would not be technically comparable.
measurement_policy.marketing_policy: No superiority, FPS, latency or memory claim may be published from shared CI wall-clock observations alone.

workloads.threshold_source: bounded residency/reuse plus 2D candidate and 3D BVH pruning thresholds

swirengine.evidence_scope: Commands are repository-owned and verified by Milestones 2, 6 and 7; this is workflow evidence, not a speed ranking.

external_reference_facts.verified_fact: Official documentation describes pip installation and a PyInstaller tutorial that bundles a simple game into a one-file executable.
Official documentation describes setuptools build_apps/bdist_apps tooling for self-contained application builds and distribution packages, including Windows, Linux and macOS targets.
Official documentation describes pip installation and ursina.build for producing a distributable build directory, with Nuitka and auto-py-to-exe alternatives also documented.
